Note for whoever takes this card (contract review 6838468174 on PR #32880, nit N2): the summary above is narrower than the rule that lands. It is not only the "HTTP MCP door", and not only "served through `run_action`". The rule is the reach of the exported `registerSkillPrompts` (any host driving its own MCP server, stdio included), and a skill's bound `action_*` entry is served by a literal or wildcard match first, else by the `run_action` door. Write the spec JSDoc / `.describe()`, `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` and `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` text from PR #32880's changeset, not from this card's summary.
